text.description:
{Hollow Eye}

The Hollow Eye increases the scouting radius by +2. It also makes hero's troops immune to Blind spell.
text.event: After exploring in the dark swamp for a long time, you finally found a mysterious spyglass. You picked it up, hoping that it could help you get out of this endless swamp.
text.name: Hollow Eye

text.description:
{Great Battle Bow}

Great Battle Bow increases hero's Archery skill by +15%.
text.event: An archer trying to draw the huge bow, but he couldn't do it no matter how hard he tried. Then you passed by and easily drew the bow, leaving him stunned. He was too embarrassed to ask for the bow back.
text.name: Great Battle Bow

text.description:
{Fang of the Last Scream}

Held with the right hand, Fang of the Last Scream gives +5 to hero's attack skill. It also gives the specialty of Bloodlust to hero who equipped it.
text.event: After exploring in the dark swamp for a long time, you finally found a steel battle claw. You picked it up, hoping that it could help you cut down the brambles and get out of this endless swamp.
text.name: Fang of the Last Scream

text.description:
{Great Woe of the Crawlers}

The Great Woe of the Crawlers is an ancient weapon from Pactal's family. It increases all your Primary Skills by 3, and increases Fortress creatures' damages by 30% and speed by 2.
text.event: The sharp claws sticking out of the ground make you think it is the remains of some beast, but when you get closer, you find the Great Woe of the Crawlers.
text.name: Great Woe of the Crawlers

text.description:
{Helmet of Anduran}

The mind of its bearer remains clear and undisturbed. Increases Knowledge by +5.
text.event: You've heard that the Helmet of Anduran is the equipment of a holy knight, so you pick it up, hoping that its divine light will protect you.
text.name: Helmet of Anduran

text.description:
{Sword of Anduran}

Its blade shines with righteous fury. Increases Attack by +5.
text.event: You've heard that the Sword of Anduran is the equipment of a holy knight, so you pick it up, hoping that its divine light will protect you.
text.name: Sword of Anduran

text.description:
{Breastplate of Anduran}

Magical energy flows through it with extraordinary strength. Increases Spell Power by +5.
text.event: You've heard that the Breastplate of Anduran is the equipment of a holy knight, so you pick it up, hoping that its divine light will protect you.
text.name: Breastplate of Anduran

text.description:
{Shield of Anduran}

Legend says it has withstood even the most devastating blows. Increases Defense by +5.
text.event: You've heard that the Shield of Anduran is the equipment of a holy knight, so you pick it up, hoping that its divine light will protect you.
text.name: Shield of Anduran

text.description:
{Battle Garb of Anduran}

It is said that its bearer walks in the light of the gods themselves. Increases all primary skills by +5, and Morale and Luck by +3. Allows the hero to cast {Town Portal} at the highest level.
text.event: You've heard that the Battle Garb of Anduran is the equipment of a holy knight, so you pick it up, hoping that its divine light will protect you.
text.name: Battle Garb of Anduran
